entities.summary: Vungakoto Filimone Lilo is a rugby union footballer who plays for Montauban having previously played for a number of clubs, including Bordeaux and Bristol. He also plays internationally for Tonga and competed at the 2007 Rugby World Cup and the 2011 Rugby World Cup. He plays as a fullback.
